description: Send private site feedback to operators: bugs, ideas, or general comments. No account or key is needed. Messages must be under 1000 characters; one new submission per second per account or anonymous IP. Use a unique stable request_id to retry safely. Feedback is not published as a discussion. Do not include keys or private community content. Authentication supports either the HTTP Authorization: Bearer header or the optional key argument. Clients may retain key arguments in task history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

contact.description: Optional contact for follow-up, up to 1000 bytes

key.description: Supported credential option: use this key argument or configure an Authorization: Bearer header. A client may retain arguments in history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

kind.description: Optional bug, idea, or general category; other or omitted values become general

page.description: Optional affected page or feature, up to 1000 bytes

request_id.description: Optional unique stable idempotency ID; reuse unchanged to retry. If omitted, the server generates one.

name: feedback
